programmes.d: The story of a young girl savagely beaten by a group of teenagers and later found dead in a river leads to a troubling inquiry whereby water causes several complications as well as the solution to the case.
The mother of two teenaged girls is found dead in her bathtub. The coroner declares it an accidental death, but a year later, new information prompt the police to reopen the case.

Two girls are attacked by a man armed with a baseball bat. One of them manages to escape but the second one is found in a salmon river. The killer nags the police for months until he leaves behind a telling clue.
The body of a woman is found floating next to a dock. The case takes the detectives into a sinister world from which few come out unharmed.

In April 1996, Winston Malcolm is rescued from icy waters of a lake after a canoe accident. He announced to hospital staff that his wife was with him. A dive team is called to the rescue, and the body of Jan Marshall is finally found a few days later.

The summer of 2007, a young girl walks on the beach and a human foot in a sneaker. Less than a week later, a couple discovers another running shoe with a foot inside of it south of there. Thus begins the mystery of the disembodied feet.

In early April 2000, two students discover the lifeless body of a young woman on the edge of a river. The victim has wounds on her neck, but a murder weapon is not found at the scene. Investigators find a piece of paper in the victim’s pant pocket.

April 1999 in the Port of Quebec City, the "Spirit of Columbus" is moored at Pier 29. A worker sees a body floating at the base of the platform. The pathologist determines that the woman had been strangled. The case is becomes a murder.
On August 4th, 2008, kayakers found a 40-year-old homeless man, Mark Hanley, floating near the marina in Nanaimo, British Columbia. He had been severely beaten and stabbed.
A young married couple's photographs of their vacation give police the clues they need to implicate the pair in the murders of two other Ocean City, Maryland vacationers.

Stacey Lannert sits in a Missouri prison, convicted of murdering her father. At the trial, she claimed that she killed him after years of sexual abuse and threats, but the jury didn't believe her. Do you?
A marriage gone bad. An affair. A bitter divorce. In 1994 in Jefferson, Wisconsin, it all led to the shooting death of Ruben Borchardt, a 40-year-old father of three.
A look at one of the most shocking and controversial cases in Hawaiian history--the 1991 rape and murder of beautiful 23-year-old Dana Ireland.

In November 1995, close friends Halima Jones and Ruby Joyner went out shopping together in Peachtree City, Georgia, but never came home. An all-out manhunt was launched, and four days later, an abandoned mini-van was found.

Linda Sobek, a pretty, vivacious Los Angeles model turns up missing after a photo shoot. The police investigation leads to photographer Charles Rathbun, who, after much back-and-forth, says he killed her by accident.
Tyler Perry helps a mother get answers about the disappearance of her son after an encounter with a cop. A second case comes to light with the same cop.
Kelley Brannon leaves everything behind at the Sunshine Inn, disappearing into the night. Friends around the country are left with shreds of evidence, all wondering where she could have gone.
Kelley vanishes from the Sunshine Inn leaving only a voicemail. Police wonder if her disappearance is tied to the strangers of Live Oak, or someone closer.
After his abandoned car is found on a mountain road, family of Matthew Weaver Jr. suspects foul play, refusing to accept a police theory of suicide.
Geologist Daniel Robinson abruptly leaves a job site in the Arizona desert. Searchers discover his SUV and clothes, but what happened to Daniel?
Marshal Iwaasa's truck is found burnt in the wilderness. Family and friends hire a fire investigator who believes police bungled a crime scene.
Jason Landry heads home from university. His car and clothes are found in rural Texas. Theories include hypothermia, abduction and man-eating pigs.
A retired couple is stabbed to death, leaving a town in fear of satanic cults. Suspicion falls on their daughter, but the truth reveals a dark, manipulative duo.
In 1997, a man and woman abduct and assault women in their minivan. As law enforcement closes in, they realize capturing these fugitives won’t be easy—they live in the van.
In 1987, a rapist terrorizes Scarborough. Police hunt him down, but he vanishes. Soon, a teenage girl’s body surfaces, leading to a shocking discovery: a sadistic newlywed couple.
Alesia Warrior and her lover Darell Rodgers kill her husband, but a botched plan forces them to up the ante to mislead police.
Teen Krystal Hall and meth maniac Patrick Connelly go on a murderous spree, ending in a violent swamp showdown.
Addict Casey Ledbetter and con-woman Jo become serial killers after their deadly scams escalate and they turn on friends.
Melanie Ray and childhood friend Chandler Clark start a love affair that spirals into murder to avoid her parole violation.
Teen Wendy Lewis’s affair with engineer Wayne Gulley leads to a deadly crime spree, taking decades to solve.
Nursing student Taiana Matheny and rap star Terry Sellers turn a romantic trip into a deadly crime spree with Taiana as the bait.
